spec_gaps.item: Strategy lookup DSN format — asyncpg.create_pool receives postgresql+asyncpg:// but only accepts postgresql:// or postgres://. strategy_storage.py line 135 passes this directly to asyncpg.create_pool() which rejects the +asyncpg suffix. Error: 'invalid DSN: scheme is expected to be either postgresql or postgres, got postgresql+asyncpg'. Fix: strip '+asyncpg' from URL before passing to asyncpg, e.g. self.database_url.replace('+asyncpg', '')
